name: Panikheti System
description: Water is diverted from upper agricultural terraces to lower terraces while maintaining the desired water level in each terrace.
purpose: Help reduce soil erosion on hill slopes
conditions: Hilly terrain with terraced agricultural fields and a suitable water source.
limitations: Requires suitable terrace layout, water availability and local water-management knowledge.

name: Apatani Rice-Fish Farming
description: Rice cultivation is integrated with fish farming in terraces. Stream water is supplied through canals, and distant fields are connected using drainage pipes.
conditions: Suitable local valley and terrace conditions, dependable water supply and appropriate fish-management practices.
limitations: Requires suitable water infrastructure and knowledge of both rice and fish management.

name: Bamboo Drip Irrigation
description: Bamboo channels carry water from hill streams at higher elevations to agricultural fields on steep slopes.
conditions: Hilly terrain with an accessible stream and a suitable gravity-fed channel route.
limitations: Depends on stream availability, terrain, channel maintenance and local construction knowledge.

name: Zabo Farming System
description: A traditional integrated farming system combining forest areas, rainwater harvesting ponds, agriculture, fishery and animal husbandry.
conditions: Hilly landscape with suitable water-harvesting and integrated farming arrangements.
limitations: Requires appropriate landscape conditions, water infrastructure and coordination of multiple farm activities.
